Any code path that instead reads the raw hideBranding column off a single entity (the event type's owner alone, the workflow's own userId/teamId, a team without its parent, a user without the booked organization's profile), or that selects only that single column from the database, breaks the contract because it silently drops the organization-level override that the booking page honours.","defect_location":{"repo":"calcom/cal.com","summary":"packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 defines the rule (resolveHideBranding: an organization's hideBranding overrides the entity's) and exposes two families of entry point.
